module_only.reason: The advisory covers golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp and its six subpackages, none of which gum imports. It names no fixed version: the affected range opens at 0 and never closes, because the finding is that the package is unmaintained rather than a defect a release can fix. golang.org/x/crypto stays in the module graph for golang.org/x/crypto/cryptobyte, which github.com/google/s2a-go reaches under cloud.google.com/go/auth, so the requirement cannot be dropped.
